messages:
Maya: Quick thread  we need final microcopy and routing for the launch post + landing update. Focus: clear CTAs for Hosted / Dedicated / Private, a webinar RSVP path, and simple lead routing. Can we lock this today?

Elliot: I sketched 3 hero lines that keep the motion short and action-focused:
- Hosted: "Hosted API: ship features fast. Start with free credits."
- Dedicated: "Dedicated GPUs: consistent throughput, SLA-backed. Request capacity."
- Private: "Private deployment: VPC & on-prem for compliance. Talk to sales."
Small supporting line: "Benchmarked at production scale ast p95s, predictable cost tradeoffs."

Sam: CTA mapping proposal:
- Primary hero CTA -> "Try free" -> Hosted signup funnel (email + org size optional)
- Secondary CTA -> "Reserve capacity" -> Dedicated capacity form (company_size required)
- Secondary alt -> "Enterprise demo" -> Private sales form (sched meeting)
Also: add a small inline webinar CTA: "See benchmarks live -> Save my spot"

Ravi: Launch posts plan: schedule three posts (product blog, Twitter X thread, LinkedIn) timed with the webinar. Each channel gets one benchmark nugget + CTA. Keep copy variations short: one stat + CTA.

Priya: Routing logic (simple pseudocode):
```
if cta == "Reserve capacity" OR company_size >= 250 => route_to = "enterprise-inbound"
else if cta == "Enterprise demo" => route_to = "ae-queue"
else => route_to = "marketing-nurture"
```
Webhook fields we should capture: email, company_name, company_size (optional), expected_rps, cta_label, page_url, utm_source

Maya: Webinar registration form: keep minimal. Fields: email (required), name (optional), company_size (optional), expected_rps (optional). Add a checkbox: "I want a follow-up demo" which maps to routing above.

preview-bot: deploy-preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/pages/launch-1769467890 (includes hero + webinar slice)

Elliot: A/B idea: headline A = product-led ("Ship features fast"), B = economics-led ("Lower your inference cost"). Run for 10 days, look at signup lift and webinar RSVP rate.

Priya: For the webhook payload example I'll include a sample once Sam posts final form field names. Also recommend a 24h SLA for enterprise-inbound triage.

Sam: Filed copy tickets and tracker: https://airtable.com/app/Launch-landing-copy (added tags: hero, webinar, routing). QA checklist added: analytics, form validation, GTM events, webhook test.

Maya: Great. Target ship: Wednesday EOD. If anyone sees blocking copy or analytics gaps, drop them here. Thanks :sparkles:
